content.value_statement: Building reusable AI skills is hard when structure, resources, and validation rules are unclear. This skill provides a practical workflow for designing, writing, validating, and packaging skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md structure and optional resource folders.
Guides planning from concrete user examples before writing instructions.
Provides templates for skill and subagent documentation.
Includes scripts to initialize, validate, and package skill folders.
Recommends progressive disclosure for large references and resources.
Gives quality checks for metadata, examples, and reusable assets.
limitations: It does not create domain expertise without user-provided requirements.
Generated skills still need human review before publication.
The validator checks structure, not full behavioral quality.
Some command examples may need path updates to match bundled script names.

use_cases.title: Create a New Workflow Skill
use_cases.description: Design a skill that captures a repeatable business or technical workflow for future agent use.

use_cases.title: Improve Existing Skill Quality
use_cases.description: Review a draft skill for unclear triggers, missing resources, placeholder text, and weak examples.

use_cases.title: Package Skills for Sharing
use_cases.description: Validate a completed skill folder and create a distributable archive for review or installation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill creator to design a simple skill for [task]. Ask for missing goals, then draft the structure.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Draft Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my existing skill folder. Identify unclear triggers, missing reusable resources, placeholder text, and validation issues.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Reusable Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these user examples, decide which scripts, references, and assets should be bundled with the skill.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Skill Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this skill for release. Check metadata, file organization, examples, resource references, and packaging readiness.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for handling monthly finance reporting.
output: A short trigger description for finance reporting tasks.
A workflow outline covering inputs, validation, report creation, and review.
Suggested references for chart of accounts, report rules, and examples.

output_examples.input: Review my draft customer-support skill before I publish it.
output: A list of unclear trigger conditions and missing concrete examples.
Recommendations for moving long policy details into reference files.
Validation and packaging steps to run after revisions.

output_examples.input: Package a completed skill folder for sharing.
output_examples.output: A validation-first packaging checklist, with expected archive output and errors to fix before distribution.

best_practices: Start from concrete user requests before choosing the skill structure.
Keep SKILL.md focused and move long details into references.
Run validation before packaging or sharing a skill.
anti_patterns: Do not leave TODO placeholders in published skill files.
Do not add scripts or assets that the workflow never uses.
Do not hide trigger guidance only inside the skill body.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create AI skills with clear triggers, reusable resources, validation checks, and packaging steps.

faq.question: Can it update an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide review, restructuring, resource planning, validation, and packaging for an existing skill.

faq.question: Does it write all domain content for me?
faq.answer: No. It needs concrete examples, requirements, or source material to create useful domain-specific instructions.

faq.question: What files does it expect?
faq.answer: A skill needs SKILL.md. Optional scripts, references, and assets are used when they support repeatable work.

faq.question: Does it include validation tools?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled validator checks basic frontmatter, naming rules, and skill folder requirements.

faq.question: Is it suitable for marketplace publication?
faq.answer: It can prepare skills for review, but authors should still verify quality, safety, and licensing before publication.
